# Domovoi

> Domovoi is a self-hosted server overseer. A hub and small agents on your Linux machines watch for problems, a model triages each incident into a card in Discord and the web UI, and nothing runs on a host unless a human approves it. It is one Rust binary with an embedded web UI, installed from a release with `install.sh` and run as systemd services or containers.

Install with `curl -fsSL https://github.com/RoastSlav/domovoi/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sudo sh -s -- --role hub|agent|both`. The installer supports `--dry-run`, `--yes` and `--json` for unattended use. Creating the Discord bot, providing an LLM key and approving actions are done by a person.

## Install and operate

- [Quick start](https://RoastSlav.github.io/domovoi/quick-start.html): the hub and an agent on one machine.
- [Binary and systemd](https://RoastSlav.github.io/domovoi/install/binary.html): every installer option, what it creates and how it fails.
- [Unattended install](https://RoastSlav.github.io/domovoi/install/unattended.html): a script from install to uninstall, the JSON output and the exit codes.
- [Docker](https://RoastSlav.github.io/domovoi/install/docker.html): the hub as a container.
- [Upgrading and uninstalling](https://RoastSlav.github.io/domovoi/install/upgrading.html)
- [Agents and enrollment](https://RoastSlav.github.io/domovoi/guide/agents.html)
